card_sentences: SAMPLE Two sisters in Sunset Park brew unsweetened oolong in small batches. They wanted a canned tea they would drink every afternoon at work.
allergen_line_verbatim: SAMPLE INGREDIENTS: BREWED OOLONG TEA (FILTERED WATER, OOLONG TEA LEAVES), PEACH JUICE CONCENTRATE, NATURAL FLAVOR, CITRIC ACID.
may_contain_verbatim: SAMPLE PRODUCED IN A FACILITY THAT ALSO HANDLES MILK AND SOY.
